title: Phase 2, architecture A: Kerr with memory + off-axis (IFWM) triplets
question: Does a Kerr stage with memory (covering the axial triplets in first order) plus off-axis triplets beat triplets only and Kerr only at equal RM, and how many off-axis terms are worth keeping?
replica_rule: replica r: numpy default_rng(r) bootstrap of the 30 train files (counts in the closed form; theta on the first n_sub distinct drawn files); validation and test fixed

value_filter.changes_next_step: yes: positive makes A the reference above the DBP range and opens phase 4; negative keeps one-step triplets
value_filter.answered_in_literature: no exact scheme found (PA-LDBP excludes IFWM, PB-DBP has full triplets per step; search incomplete)
value_filter.needed_for_main_claim: yes: it tests whether the triplet advantage is IFWM
value_filter.cheaper_without_training: yes: closed form + L-BFGS on a subsample

decision_if_positive: report A as the best architecture at its RM; joint fine-tuning (Adam) of the best A per arch; phase 4 (E041) may run
decision_if_negative: negative result as is: the Kerr split does not help over plain triplets at equal RM

modes.varpro: A1, A3, A3full: theta by L-BFGS with C eliminated (variable projection) on the subsample
modes.seq: Kerr alone first, then ridge on the residual (A2: ridge first, then Kerr)
modes.closed: T: T3 + FIR7 closed form (as E031)

joint_adam: not in this stage: joint fine-tuning from the closed-form solution is a follow-up if A is positive
rm: Kerr 4 L + 2 + (N_c + 1)/2 + 4 (FIR7 non-symmetric, symmetric alpha), 12 per off-axis merged term; T: 12 per term + 28

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
rule_draft.a_wins: architecture A wins if, at equal RM (rival RM <= 1.05 x RM of A), its best configuration by validation is better in test than both the best triplets-only (T) and the best Kerr-only (K) by more than 2 std over replicas (std = the largest of the compared); otherwise negative
rule_draft.double_count: reported: (Kerr + T3 with axes) - (Kerr + off-axis), same M and N_c

splits_stage: the best configuration by validation of each arch (A1, A2, A3, A3full, T, K; full sets) on the three E023 file splits x 5 replicas (protocol: 5 training seeds x 3 split seeds)
